title: Petrichor
description: Final project for my Computer Tools for Musicians class at Tufts. Produced in Digital Performer 11, featuring my vocals accompanied by synthesizers from Reason and MOTU.

title: Thinking of Her
description: The first track in my two-song Lofi single 'Thinking of Her', released in the summer of 2023 and produced in Logic Pro X. This song started as a loop I made for my game design class for a game centered around cheese, but it found a new meaning when I completed it. It's inspired by insomnia and the thoughts of others (specifically her lmao) that creep into your mind when there's nothing else to do.

title: Close Your Eyes
description: The second half of my two-song Lofi single 'Thinking of Her', released in the summer of 2023 and produced in Logic Pro X. It opens at the onset of a dream, where a man dances alone in the darkness. A woman, the woman of his dreams, spirals toward him. When they meet, her touch pulls him out of the dark and into a small park nestled in a busy city, where they waltz together for a brief moment. Then she spirals away, and he is left dancing alone in the darkness once more.

title: Save the Last Dance for Me
description: My senior solo arrangement for the Tufts Beelzebubs — a 15-person TTBB a cappella group. We performed it in funny costumes, which is a Beelzebubs tradition. You can see the costumed performance by clicking the watch button. The arrangement was not tracked, so there is no audio available on this page.

title: What's New Scooby-Doo?
description: Arranged for a 12-person TTBB a cappella group, appearing on the Tufts Beelzebubs EP 'School's Out', released December 2024.
